name: dev-kit
description: Phase-based dev / tester / audit / identity workflows with a shared project memory (AGENTS.md + docs/) and Notati task-board sync, plus start-init to set up any project.

interface.shortDescription: Phase workflows + shared project memory + Notati sync
interface.longDescription: start-init sets up AGENTS.md, docs/PROJECT_CONFIG.md and the project memory in any repository. dev executes a phase, tester verifies and closes tasks under review, audit proves and fixes security, calculation and performance findings, identity locks a measured visual identity. Claude Code and Codex share the same project files.
